procedures.title: Route each plan to one owner
procedures.definition_of_done: Every plan row has one section and one subsection, and each deliverable names one owner doc; jsony reports no parallel copy.
procedures.advice: One section and one subsection per row; the stable topic pages own the detail. Each deliverable names one owner doc or section; other docs refer to it instead of restating it.
procedures.inputs: a plan or debate row without an owner, or a deliverable without one owner doc
procedures.outputs: one owner per plan in wiki/INDEX.md and one owner doc per deliverable
procedures.gates: jsony: one section and one subsection per row; task and index point to the same owner; no parallel copy

procedures.title: Hold the floor before polish
procedures.definition_of_done: validaty floor checks pass on the page before any depth work begins.
procedures.advice: Validate a11y, privacy and structure before any depth work.
procedures.inputs: a new or edited page before depth work
procedures.outputs: a page validated for a11y, privacy and structure
procedures.gates: validaty: the floor checks pass before polish

procedures.title: Check the JSON backbone
procedures.definition_of_done: jsony validates envelopes and routing; no envelope lacks an owner.
procedures.advice: Validate envelopes and routing before a checkout is shared.
procedures.outputs: validated envelopes ready for a checkout

procedures.title: Round-trip the export
procedures.definition_of_done: exporty round-trip returns identical rows from JSON to HTML card to import.
procedures.advice: Save, share and import must return the same portrait.
procedures.inputs: flove-portrait/1 JSON and the HTML card
procedures.outputs: the same portrait after save, share and import

procedures.title: Close Frontend levels by section
procedures.definition_of_done: optimizy advice for the page and its section is recorded; no new standard detail was added.
procedures.advice: Run optimizy per page; it advises execution, not new standard detail.
procedures.inputs: a Frontend page and its section
procedures.gates: optimizy: advice recorded without new standard detail

procedures.title: Keep the library healthy
procedures.definition_of_done: check-skills.py exits 0, warnings are resolved or explained, and the skills map is synced in standards/README.md.
procedures.advice: After editing a skill, run skilly once and sync the map in standards/README.md.
procedures.inputs: an edited skill and its SKILL.md
procedures.outputs: skilly result and the synced skills map
procedures.gates: skilly: 0 errors; warnings resolved or explained in the report; map synced in standards/README.md

procedures.title: Order tasks by unblocking, then ease
procedures.definition_of_done: A recommended order exists for every stage, every candidate shows its `u` unlock count, changes no stage or state, records loops and C6 exceptions, and never blocks the queue.
procedures.advice: Advisory only. Let `u` be the number of **open hitos that depend on this hito** (open-hito unlock); rank by `u` descending, then sort tasks by their OWN effort very easy (1) → easy (2) → medium (3) → hard (4) → very hard (5), then stable ids, within stages 1–5 (seed · infant · mature · grown · full). `tasky.py next`, `easy`, `rewindow` and `show` print `u=`; the task-level `depends_on` graph supplies the blockers. Loops warn and continue; record C6 exceptions; never block.
procedures.inputs: the task queue with stage, effort, hito- and task-level depends_on graph, and the open-hito set
procedures.outputs: a recommended order for every stage that changes no stage and no state, printing the exact sort key
procedures.gates: recommendation only: check prerequisites before starting, record C6 exceptions and any loop, never block the queue

procedures.title: Specify tasks from milestones
procedures.definition_of_done: Each task has a concrete title, a done-criterion, an owner path and an evidence pointer with kind and value before any state move; parcial names remaining work.
procedures.advice: Specify each task from its milestone: concrete title naming the deliverable (no template or stage-label suffix), a done-criterion, the owner path, and an evidence pointer with kind (command|anchor|state) and value. Require evidence before a state move; a parcial task names what remains; sweep template debt back through this procedure.
procedures.inputs: a milestone (hito), its stage, section and dependency context, and pendiente or parcial tasks
procedures.outputs: spec-driven tasks with a concrete title, done-criterion, owner path and machine-readable evidence pointer
procedures.gates: jsony: no template title on hecha/parcial; done-criterion and evidence {kind, value} before a state move; parcial names remaining work; sweep findings fixed through this procedure

procedures.title: Replenish the live queue as tasks are done
procedures.definition_of_done: common.json matches milestones.json, Work --check is green, live count is between 1,200 and 1,559, and the window review has a date and reviewer.
procedures.advice: When live tasks descend below replenishBelow (1,200), specify new tasks in the 1 seed + 3 infant + 3 mature shape until the queue approaches recommendedMax (1,504); never exceed hardCap (1,559) with 55 slots reserved. Keep about 30 active-window tasks fully specified with owner and evidence, re-ranked weekly with a date in activeWindow.reviewed and the reviewer in activeWindow.reviewedBy. Marking a task done moves it to the Work archive section; the cap never grows by accumulation — a new hito needs an achieved hito archived or merged first.
procedures.inputs: the live and archived counts in Work / common.json, taskSet.queuePolicy and the Work archive section
procedures.outputs: new specified tasks up to recommendedMax, a reviewed window with date and reviewer, and updated live/archive counts
procedures.gates: jsony: common.json matches milestones.json; build-work-tracker.py --check green; live count between replenishBelow and hardCap after replenishment; window review recorded

procedures.title: Weigh decision consequence before asking
procedures.definition_of_done: Every live task has an advisory choice_weight class (`directo` · `ramificado` · `estructurante`) with a score and a question depth; the class is orthogonal to effort, changes no stage or state, and is filterable in Work and mirrored in common.json.
procedures.advice: Classify from the declared graph: `estructurante` when u ≥ 3, or fan-out ≥ 10, or the owner is a canonical schema/envelope/route/index, or g ≥ 2 declared dependencies; `ramificado` when u = 2, or fan-out 3–9, or the `Decision:` clause contains vs / or / which / who; `directo` otherwise. Offer A/B/C solutions with ★ on the owner default; ask 0, 1 or 3 questions, the last as a questy-all batch. A task may tune its class with `choice_override` + `choice_reason`; the gate keeps the override and shows the reason. Hard-register a new dependency only after the answer, in `depends_on` with `choice_reason`; no new envelope and no flag outside the row.
procedures.inputs: hito and task `depends_on` graph, the open-hito set, owner paths, the `Decision:` clause and any `choice_override` on the task
procedures.outputs: a class and score per task in tasky and common.json, the `Dependencias / Dependencies` filter in Work (keyed `choice`), and an A/B/C solution batch for the tasks that need a decision
procedures.gates: jsony: `choice` is one of the three canonical classes in Work and common.json; `tasky.py weight` / `options` read the same projection; no stage or state changed by the classification Every ★ recommendation states its reason and its con in the same line (questy ★ rule); `options` prints both, and the survey never offers a bare default.
